item.text:
Document QnA is not limited to PDFs. Mistral’s Document AI OCR supports both PDFs and images, including `.png` and `.jpg`, via an image URL or Base64-encoded image. You can then use the extracted content for question answering. [OCR Processor documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/basic_ocr)

Mistral’s Document QnA documentation describes the capability as OCR plus language-model understanding, so it is suitable for questions about text contained in an image. [Document QnA documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/document_qna)

For general visual questions—such as interpreting a chart, diagram, or image content beyond extracted text—use a vision-capable model directly.
